verdict_reason: Thorough cover of tab selection, its log, the Type cell, current-tab marking and tab links keeping the search, with one test title claiming more than its assertions prove.

todos.issue: The title 'holds the selected tab in the filter form so a search stays on it' claims a search stays on the tab, but the assertions (lines 218-221) only check the form's hidden input type, name and value; no search is submitted or followed. The 'so a search stays on it' clause is a claim the test does not prove.
todos.fix: Must: the title states only what the assertions prove, or the assertions prove the search stays on the tab. One way: retitle to 'holds the selected tab as a hidden addressType input in the filter form', or keep the title and add an assertion that the form's action plus its inputs submit addressType=BRANCH with q.
